description: Open and flowing. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: unclear with extended counter run, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor. Secondary bedroom 2 — accessed via own door off corridor. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room / home office + children's bedroom simultaneously. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible.
